snippet.title: GANG OF FROGS X MEGABIT PUBLISHING Official Announcement | Coming 2027
snippet.description:
Gang of Frogs is launching in Early Access in 2027. Join the Discord & playtests now: https://discord.gg/gangoffrogs 

Somewhere beyond the edge of known space, a gang of the galaxy’s most wanted amphibians are cooking up a plan. It’s reckless, it’s loud, and it’s almost certainly going to end in an explosion of gunfire.  

Gang of Frogs is an all-action co-op shooter that drops players into the far reaches of the galaxy to unleash gun-blazing chaos. Solo or with up to three friends, you’ll fight through hordes of monsters and bugs, explore strange civilisations and pull off high-stakes raids against the galaxy’s ruling elite in hand-crafted worlds teeming with danger and surprises.  

 

Are you hopping aboard?

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@gang.of.frogs
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/playgangoffrogs/
X: https://x.com/gang_of_frogs
Discord: https://discord.gg/gangoffrogs

Follow Megabit:
